card.name: Words ahead of harm or pathogen terms
card.fires_on: Linking words and word parts just before a harm-related term such as abuse, diversion, theft, a causative organism, or a pathogen name. Seen in label text on misuse, infection and resistance.

modes.label: Before misuse terms
modes.description: Words like detect or a comma right before abuse, diversion or theft in drug-control advice.

modes.label: Before organism terms
modes.description: Small words such as of or the right before organism or causative microorganism in dosing-by-infection text.

modes.label: Inside pathogen names
modes.description: The last piece of a pathogen or infection name, such as HBV or Meningococcal.
